body.message:
Safi, the 1BR in Upside Living is currently AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive. VAT, water, electricity, and internet are all covered, so nothing extra on top.

On the pricing point, this rate reflects where the market sits for a fully managed, all-inclusive unit in this building. Rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks, so the first period locks in at AED 7,000.

One thing worth knowing: Upside Living is adults-only, so no children are permitted.

Does the adults-only setup work for you?
